name: zhida-codex
description: Connect Codex to Zhida conversations, retrieval logs, and direct knowledge or keyword edits.

interface.shortDescription: Optimize Zhida knowledge bases from real support traces.
interface.longDescription: Zhida Codex connects Codex to the authorized Zhida project through OAuth and a hosted MCP server. It can inspect conversations and retrieval traces, search knowledge base or keyword entries, and apply reviewed direct edits after confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Find the refund knowledge entry and update its answer.
Add a keyword rule for refund status questions.
Analyze recent Zhida replies and propose knowledge changes.
Inspect this request_id and explain the retrieval trace.
Preview a knowledge or keyword changeset for these fixes.
